reconciliation.note_gross_revenue: Per-property revenue is disclosed on a GROSS RENTAL INCOME (GRI) basis on the property cards (pp53-57), NOT on the audited Gross Revenue basis. The 27 consolidated properties' GRI sums to ~S$164.7m, which equals the portfolio GRI (excl. the 49% Optus JV). The audited portfolio Gross Revenue is S$186.626m (p158) — higher than GRI because it additionally includes service charges/land rent/property tax recoverables and sale of electricity & RECs. The row-level GRI sum is reconciled here at its own (GRI) basis; it is NOT expected to equal the S$186.6m gross-revenue line, which is a different and broader basis.
